news.title: War Widens in the Black Sea in a Test of NATO Red Lines
news.summary: After seven strikes on cargo ships near NATO members Romania and Bulgaria last month, the US-led military alliance said it would deploy maritime patrol aircraft, radars and drones to bolster its eastern flank in the Black Sea.

news.title: Iran Says Contacts Over Ending War Continue After Talks Finish With No Breakthrough
news.summary: Contacts between Iran and the United States to end their eight-month war are continuing, Tehran said on Monday, after days of Iranian talks with Qatari mediators ended with altered proposals but no breakthrough.
